_about: A look pack names a type family as a class, not a font. This maps each class to a stack of faces already on a Mac or Windows machine, so nothing downloads and no licence is taken on. A face shipped inside a video or a look pack needs its own licence row first (C-TYPE-15, docs/CARRYOVER.md): OFL or an explicit web or app licence; until then looks use system stacks and a render is pixel-identical per machine, not across machines. Edit by hand; vkit sync-reference does not write this file.
